Stadium 2 Battle Sprites v1.0

Stadium 2 Battle Sprites for PokeMMO.

[b]What it changes[/b]
- Pokemon Stadium 2 models as animated battle sprites (front + back)
- Per-species scale table so they sit correctly on the battle floor

[b]Install[/b]
1. Download [b]stadium-2-battle-sprites-1-0.mod[/b] below.
2. In PokeMMO open [b]Mod Management[/b] (login screen, or the menu on Android).
3. [b]Import Mod[/b] and pick the file -- or [b]Open Mods Folder[/b] and drop it in.
4. Tick [b]Enable[/b], save, and restart the client.

[b]Compatible with[/b] client revision 32920
